FunctionName.description: Function name, unqualified. Appears in the hostname, the function name and the log group paths. Constraint: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 20 characters

ServiceEnvironment.description: Environment name — a configuration directory, not a git branch. Appears in the hostname. Constraint: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 12 characters

ImageUri.description: ECR image built against a Lambda base image, or implementing the runtime API. Pin by digest — Lambda resolves a tag ONCE at deploy and never re-checks it, so moving a tag changes nothing until the next stack update, which is a confusing way to find out. Constraint: an ECR image reference; Lambda cannot run an image from anywhere else

MemorySizeMb.description: Memory, and proportionally CPU — they are the same dial. A function is often CHEAPER at higher memory because it finishes sooner; 1769 MB is one full vCPU. Measure before economising. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config (>= 128, <= 10240).

TimeoutSeconds.description: Function timeout, up to 900. API Gateway gives up at 29 seconds regardless, so anything above that only matters for a non-HTTP invoker. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config (>= 1, <= 900).

ReservedConcurrency.description: Cap on simultaneous executions. -1 means unreserved: this function can consume the whole account's 1000-concurrency pool and starve every other function in it. A number both bounds the blast radius and bounds the bill. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config (>= -1, <= 1000).

AttachToVpc.description: Run in the workspace private subnets. Required to reach a database; costs an ENI per concurrent execution and gives the function NO internet route unless the subnets have a NAT gateway.

ThrottlingBurstLimit.description: Requests absorbed in a burst before throttling. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config (>= 1).

ThrottlingRateLimit.description: Steady-state requests per second. This is the only ceiling on what a loop in someone else's code can cost you — API Gateway has no free tier after the first year. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config (>= 1).

CorsAllowOrigin.description: Single allowed origin, or empty for no CORS configuration. A literal * is rejected here on purpose: it cannot be combined with credentials, and an API that needs any origin usually has not decided who its callers are. Constraint: empty, or a single https origin — not *

LogRetentionDays.description: Retention for both the access log and the function log. Never leave either unbounded. CFN Type: Number, written as a string in the config.

JwtIssuer.description: OIDC issuer URL for a JWT authorizer, or empty for an API with NO authorization at all. Empty means every route is public to the internet — correct for a public endpoint, a mistake anywhere else.

JwtAudience.description: Expected audience claim. Required when JwtIssuer is set.

JwtAudience.$comment: JwtAudience is required when JwtIssuer is set — an authorizer that validates the signature but not the audience accepts any token the same issuer ever minted, for any application
